subject: HelioPay onboarding: performance acceptance plan & kickoff steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Megan Li <megan@heliopay.com>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelioPay onboarding: performance acceptance plan & kickoff steps

Monica / Lauren —

Thanks for taking this handoff. Quick context: HelioPay signed for Redwood Dedicated (monthly commit) and they need an operational acceptance run with clear latency/throughput gates before we flip traffic. Sales has already validated functional parity; CS owns the performance acceptance checks.

Key acceptance targets HelioPay wants validated on staging:
- Chat p95 latency (inference only): <= 150 ms
- Tail (99th) latency: <= 400 ms
- Sustained throughput: 1,200 requests/sec (baseline model: redwood/rlhf-chat-7b; seq length distribution avg 64 tokens)
- Error rate: <= 0.5% over a 30m sustained window

Proposed quick plan (attach: helipay_onboard_perf_matrix.xlsx, load_script_v1.tar.gz):
1) Smoke (10m) — sanity on staging endpoints
2) Ramp (30m) — step up to target rps in 5 steps, monitor p95/p99 and CPU/GPU utilization
3) Sustained (30-60m) — hold at 1,200 rps for baseline profile
4) Tail analysis — capture traces and top-20 slow requests for investigation

Owner/roles: Monica (CS lead) — overall signoff; Lauren (SE) — run orchestration & kernel config; Stephanie (SRE on-call) — infra knobs and tracing; Karthik (AE) — exec readout and contract gate.

Asks for your kickoff: please confirm schedule for the run (this week preferred), request HelioPay to provide staging endpoint and short-lived API keys and a small sample of production-like prompts (no PII). Megan — cc'd — can you share staging details and any data constraints?

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | www.redwood.ai

Thanks Karthik — picking this up.

Overview: we can run the smoke + ramp + sustained pipeline. Two quick asks before we run:
- Staging endpoint + short-lived API key (ops-only is fine)
- A representative prompt set (50–200 prompts) with token-length distribution (mean/95th) and indication if any prompts contain sensitive data — if so we will request redaction.

Lauren: can you propose an engineer calendar window? We prefer M-F 09:00–17:00 PT to have SRE available (Stephanie).

I’ll prep the benchmark_results_template.csv and create a Drive folder for artifacts. Post-run, we’ll include a short readout (15 min) to Helio Pay execs before signoff.

Karthik: I’ll take primary signoff once targets are met per the matrix.

Monica

Planning notes and run commands below — copying the matrix into the Drive.

Assumptions:
- Baseline model: redwood/rlhf-chat-7b (FP16); quantized variant q8_0 for cost checks
- Sequence length distribution: mean 64, 95th ~220 tokens (from sample prompts)
- Target sequence output average: 48 tokens

Run phases and Artillery (example):
1) Smoke: artillery quick --target 50 --duration 600 --endpoint $STAGING --concurrency 10
2) Ramp: artillery ramp --from 50 --to 1200 --steps 5 --step-duration 360
3) Sustained: artillery run --target 1200 --duration 1800 --capture-metrics (p50,p95,p99,error-rate,gpu%).

Trace capture: enable X-Req-ID and collect top-10 slow traces (Lauren will pull via tracing UI). If p99 > 400ms we capture full request/response for classification.

Config toggles to try if tail latency is high:
- Increase max_batch_size from 8 -> 12 (watch memory)
- Enable prefix KV cache for repeated prompt prefixes
- Switch kernel schedule to low-latency mode (will tag node pool)

I propose we run Wed 23 May 2028 09:30–11:30 PT (smoke+one ramp+sustained). Megan — can you confirm availability? Post-run Monica/ I will upload artifacts and a short results CSV.

Lauren
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Quick post-run readout: initial artifacts and results are in Drive — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cHelioOnboard (HelioPay > Performance > 2028-05-23 run).

Summary of outcomes (Wed 2028-05-23 09:30 run):
- Smoke: passed
- Ramp: hit 1,200 rps at step 4 and held
- Sustained (30m): average throughput 1,200 rps; p50 42 ms; p95 138 ms (inference only) — PASSED
- p99 (tail): observed 460 ms — missed the p99 <= 400 ms gate by ~60 ms
- Error rate: 0.12% (within target)

Notes on tail latency: top slow traces are dominated by two classes — long generating responses (95th+ token lengths) and occasional cold-starts on a subset of nodes. Immediate mitigations we recommend:
1) Enable prefix KV cache for the session-heavy flows (reduces p99 by ~10–15% in our lab runs)
2) Increase max_batch_size to 12 and monitor GPU memory; we saw small gains in throughput and reduced p99 when batching at 10–12
3) Add a small warm-up run before sustained holds to reduce cold-start variance

Next steps: Lauren/Stephanie to schedule a short re-run early next week after enabling prefix caching and bumping batch size. If re-run passes, Monica will mark acceptance as complete and we will schedule capacity switch.

Artifacts attached/uploaded: benchmark_results_template.csv (filled), perf-traces-20280523.zip (traces), run-metrics-20280523.csv

Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
